org.postgresql.Driver.name: jaasLogin
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Login with JAAS before doing GSSAPI authentication

org.postgresql.Driver.name: kerberosServerName
org.postgresql.Driver.description: The Kerberos service name to use when authenticating with GSSAPI.

org.postgresql.Driver.name: loadBalanceHosts
org.postgresql.Driver.description: If disabled hosts are connected in the given order. If enabled hosts are chosen randomly from the set of suitable candidates

org.postgresql.Driver.name: localSocketAddress
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Local Socket address, if set bind the client side of the socket to this address

org.postgresql.Driver.name: loggerFile
org.postgresql.Driver.description: File name output of the Logger

org.postgresql.Driver.name: loggerLevel
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Logger level of the driver

org.postgresql.Driver.name: loginTimeout
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Specify how long in seconds to wait for establishment of a database connection.

org.postgresql.Driver.name: logServerErrorDetail
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Include full server error detail in exception messages. If disabled then only the error itself will be included.

org.postgresql.Driver.name: logUnclosedConnections
org.postgresql.Driver.description: When connections that are not explicitly closed are garbage collected, log the stacktrace from the opening of the connection to trace the leak source

org.postgresql.Driver.name: maxResultBuffer
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Specifies size of buffer during fetching result set. Can be specified as specified size or percent of heap memory.

org.postgresql.Driver.name: options
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Specify 'options' connection initialization parameter.

org.postgresql.Driver.name: password
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Password to use when authenticating.

org.postgresql.Driver.name: PGDBNAME
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Database name to connect to (may be specified directly in the JDBC URL)

org.postgresql.Driver.name: PGHOST
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Hostname of the PostgreSQL server (may be specified directly in the JDBC URL)

org.postgresql.Driver.name: PGPORT
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Port of the PostgreSQL server (may be specified directly in the JDBC URL)

org.postgresql.Driver.name: preferQueryMode
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Specifies which mode is used to execute queries to database: simple means ('Q' execute, no parse, no bind, text mode only), extended means always use bind/execute messages, extendedForPrepared means extended for prepared statements only, extendedCacheEverything means use extended protocol and try cache every statement (including Statement.execute(String sql)) in a query cache.

org.postgresql.Driver.name: preparedStatementCacheQueries
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Specifies the maximum number of entries in per-connection cache of prepared statements. A value of {@code 0} disables the cache.

org.postgresql.Driver.name: preparedStatementCacheSizeMiB
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Specifies the maximum size (in megabytes) of a per-connection prepared statement cache. A value of {@code 0} disables the cache.

org.postgresql.Driver.name: prepareThreshold
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Statement prepare threshold. A value of {@code -1} stands for forceBinary

org.postgresql.Driver.name: protocolVersion
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Force use of a particular protocol version when connecting, currently only version 3 is supported.

org.postgresql.Driver.name: quoteReturningIdentifiers
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Quote identifiers provided in returning array

org.postgresql.Driver.name: readOnly
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Puts this connection in read-only mode

org.postgresql.Driver.name: readOnlyMode
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Controls the behavior when a connection is set to be read only, one of 'ignore', 'transaction', or 'always' When 'ignore', setting readOnly has no effect. When 'transaction' setting readOnly to 'true' will cause transactions to BEGIN READ ONLY if autocommit is 'false'. When 'always' setting readOnly to 'true' will set the session to READ ONLY if autoCommit is 'true' and the transaction to BEGIN READ ONLY if autocommit is 'false'.

org.postgresql.Driver.name: receiveBufferSize
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Socket read buffer size

org.postgresql.Driver.name: replication

Only the simple query protocol can be used in walsender mode. Passing 'database' as the value instructs walsender to connect to the database specified in the dbname parameter, which will allow the connection to be used for logical replication from that database. (backend >= 9.4)

org.postgresql.Driver.name: reWriteBatchedInserts

org.postgresql.Driver.description: The Windows SSPI service class for SPN

org.postgresql.Driver.name: targetServerType
org.postgresql.Driver.description: Specifies what kind of server to connect

org.postgresql.Driver.description: Enable or disable TCP keep-alive. The default is {@code false}.

org.postgresql.Driver.description: Enable or disable TCP no delay. The default is (@code true}.
